reason: Squirrel northwest, Stoddard/Green west, Kirby north-central, John east and Blanche southeast provide two-axis island distribution.
corrections: John Island northern target initially selected a tiny neighbouring island; corrected to the large island physical northern shore before fitting.
unadopted: Fish, Sherose, Split Point, Sheep Ledge and Southwest Rock details did not provide sufficiently confident equivalent outlines; excluded before fit.
limitations: Six checks pair with control islands; Coesars Pond provides a separate inland check. Shared historical cartography limits independence.
Northern/eastern mainland, Cape Sable sandbar, town harbours and much of the central coast remain independently unvalidated.
Tidal islands and generalized extrema carry 24 px working source uncertainty; island-size differences are visible.
Small offshore ledges, altered shore connections and unmatched sandbars remain included but were not forced into controls.
